ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters; approximately 85:15 ratio of dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters are concentrated on the superior-distal margins of both lobes, with smaller isolated circular spots distributed across the central-left and central-right regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing margin; right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of low-amplitude peaks compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the superior trailing edge, terminating in acute, slightly upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white spots (rosettes) located on the upper-left and upper-right margins, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal light-intensity linear marks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigmentation of the left lobe; additional horizontal linear disruptions visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular 'ring' scar located in the medial-left lobe quadrant; extensive multi-directional linear abrasions across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast circular 'doughnut' shaped scar situated between the median notch and the left distal tip.
